SuperUnicode 0.1.0

Release notes — 2026-08-14.

The first release. Everything here is compiled, tested and attested with CRC32c + Fletcher-64:

  • Base SUCS — 31-bit space, hierarchy, three-space layout, SCP/Traps/Sentinel.
  • Machine-Instruction Database — the Public/ trees for Base and Extended with SUCD.zip / ExtSUCD.zip and per-component archives.
  • Plugin subsystem — stage → reboot → checksum gate → OWFS plugin partition → range registration, with quarantine.
  • Plugin SDK — template, hellocp example, plugin_pack and plugin_verify tools.
  • Reference implementations — SUTF8/16/32, extSUTF (vector/vsutf), SUST serialization transports (SUST-16 BE/LE, fixed, e-SUST), SUCA, SDF/BiDi, SGW width/grid, SBR line breaking, SUCF canonical (de)composition and the one-TU unified header test.
  • The website — a multi-page mirror of unicode.org, plus repository directory listings.

Validation

The 0.1.0 suite runs 15 tests (framing, planes, plugin lifecycle, serialization transports, SDF/BiDi, SUCA collation, SGW width/grid, SBR line breaking, SUCF canonical forms, unified headers) — all passing on the reference build.

Known limits: no native allocations yet, the SCP registry is empty pending assignments, and SUCA ships a curated default SUCET subset (full per-language tables pending native data).
